spans.s: चिदुल्लास, i. e. चित्-, adj. rejoicing the mind, Bhāg.
चिद् (properly acc. n. of a lost indefinite pronoun चि = τι; Lat. qui + s), a particle giving to the preceding word an indefinite signification: Any,

= Rigv. i. 49, 3. In classic language it is only used after derivatives of the interrogative pronouns किम्, and जतु, and gives them an indefinite signification; cf. कथम्, कदा, किम्, कुतस्, क्व, and जातु.
 --Cf. Lat. -que (= Oscan -pid) in quando-que = कदा चिद्, (qui)-cumque = कम् चिद्.
